The router adds an optional **Sub-agents** tab through Bett"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"er Sidebar's public `registerTab` API."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## See it in action"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"### Follow every specialist from Better Sidebar"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"*See parallel delegated work, current status, and the selected model together in the task tree you a"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"l delegated work, current status, and the selected model together in the task tree you already use.*"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### Build your ideal model team"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"*Define friendly routes and tell the orchestrator when each model shines—from quick, budget-friendly"},{"id":"p13s2","text":" tasks to your most demanding work.*"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## What it adds"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- `subagent_model`: a delegation tool whose `model` argument is restricted to user-configured aliase"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"s.

- `model_subag"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"ent_catalog`: a read-only view of models advertised by registered LLM providers.
